intro: I'm Zayd Mulani, a high-school senior in New Jersey. I build simulations that run on the GPU inside a browser tab, and Rust command-line tools for people who work with language models.
Before this I worked as a data and ML engineering intern. I'm applying to colleges, and I'm looking for an internship or a research position for next summer.

projects.note: A local-first memory layer for LLM pipelines. It extracts entities into a SQLite knowledge graph and scores context back into the next prompt. Works with Ollama, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
A slime mould simulation, up to a million agents on the GPU, that grows a transit network across cities you place and scores it against the minimum spanning tree.
A finite-difference time-domain solve of Maxwell's equations for your floor plan. Draw the walls, drop a router, drag it and watch the dead zones move.
A coverage-guided fuzzer for network protocols and binary formats. An LLM writes the seed corpus and nothing else.
A hybrid vector database: HNSW for dense retrieval, BM25 for lexical search, fused at query time. One binary, no cloud.
A superoptimiser that searches on the GPU for the shortest branchless program computing a function of 32-bit words, then checks the winner against all 2^32 inputs.
Motion amplification in the browser. It magnifies colour changes too small to see, so blood moving through a face becomes visible and a heart rate falls out of it.
projects.embedNote: It keeps camera access to its own origin, so it will not run inside a frame here.

projects.note: A reverse proxy for MCP servers: routing, auth, rate limiting and request logging in one binary.
A local token and cost tracker for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. It proxies locally, stores to SQLite and reads out in a TUI.
